mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies around Firemans Park with temperatures feeling like 93 degrees and an air quality index of 54.
The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K through 12 students. Submissions are open until July 22, and the winning designs will be featured on stickers given to voters in November.
We have plenty to look forward to, with Live Music at Baileys Run and Live Music at Lake Louie happening today, plus Yoga at Insight Wellness taking place tomorrow.
Looking at the police report from July 13, officers arrested a driver for O-W-I after the vehicle became stuck on a rock while bystanders attempted to assist.
Today is the perfect time to enjoy the OREO Cookie Overload at Culvers. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
